title: Config JSON Schema for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer
description: The JSON schema for a config file for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer. NOTE: Comments and trailing commas in this file are only supported in Ore UI Customizer versions v1.17.0+BUILD.8 and later.

$schema.description: The JSON schema for a config file for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer.

hardcoreModeToggleAlwaysClickable.title: Hardcore Mode Toggle Always Clickable
hardcoreModeToggleAlwaysClickable.description: This will allow you to turn hardcore mode on and off whenever you want.

allowDisablingEnabledExperimentalToggles.title: Allow Disabling Enabled Experimental Toggles
allowDisablingEnabledExperimentalToggles.description: This will allow you to disable the experimental toggles even after the world has been played with them on, also applies to the `Education Edition` toggle.

addGeneratorTypeDropdown.title: Add Generator Type Dropdown
addGeneratorTypeDropdown.description:
This will add a dropdown that allows you to select the world generator type.
It lets you choose any of the following world generator types:
- `Legacy`
- `Infinite world`
- `Flat world`
- `Void world`

addMoreDefaultGameModes.title: Add More Default Game Modes
addMoreDefaultGameModes.description:
This will add more options to the `Game Mode` dropdown.
It will cause the dropdown to have the following options:
- `Survival`
- `Creative`
- `Adventure`
- `Default`
- `Spectator`

allowForChangingSeeds.title: Allow For Changing Seeds
allowForChangingSeeds.description: This will allow you to change the world seed whenever you want, also works on marketplace worlds that don't let you change the seed.

allowForChangingFlatWorldPreset.title: Allow For Changing Flat World Preset
allowForChangingFlatWorldPreset.description:
This will allow you to change the flat world preset, even after the world has been created.
Note: This option requires that the addGeneratorTypeDropdown option is enabled.

maxTextLengthOverride.title: Max Text Length Override
maxTextLengthOverride.description: If specified, this will override the max length of every text box to be the specified value. Leave it blank to not override it.

addDebugTab.title: Add Debug Tab
addDebugTab.description:
This adds the `Debug` tab to the create and edit world screens.
It also has a bunch of additional options added to the tab that aren't normally in there.

add8CrafterUtilitiesMainMenuButton.title: Add 8Crafter Utilities Main Menu Button
add8CrafterUtilitiesMainMenuButton.description: This adds a button in the top right of the screen on the title bar to get access to the 8Crafter Utilities menu, this allows you to access certain menus without a keyboard shortcut, and has information and the auto rejoiner menu.

enabledBuiltInPlugins.title: Enabled Built-In Plugins
enabledBuiltInPlugins.description: An object that lists whether or not each built-in plugin is enabled.

add-exact-ping-count-to-servers-tab.title: Add Exact Ping Count to Servers Tab
add-exact-ping-count-to-servers-tab.description: A built-in plugin that adds the exact ping count to the servers tab.

add-max-player-count-to-servers-tab.title: Add Max Player Count to Servers Tab
add-max-player-count-to-servers-tab.description: A built-in plugin that adds the max player count to the servers tab.

facet-spy.title: Facet Spy
facet-spy.description:
Facet spy.
IMPORTANT: This built-in plugin is being deprecated.

lite-play-screen-routes.title: Lite Play Screen Routes
lite-play-screen-routes.description: Injects the routes for the lite play screen into the routes.json and index.js files.

make-export-world-button-visible.title: Make Export World Button Visible
make-export-world-button-visible.description: A built-in plugin that makes the export world button visible on non-Windows platforms, such as Android.

oneOf.title: Legacy Pre-v1.0.0 Config
oneOf.description: The legacy pre-v1.0.0 JSON format for the configs for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer.

format_version.title: Format Version (Legacy)
format_version.description: The version of 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer that this legacy config is made for.
format_version.$comment: The default value of this should be the latest version of the Ore UI Customizer. The examples of this should include every version of the Ore UI Customizer since initial config support was added.

oreUICustomizerConfig.title: Ore UI Customizer Config
oreUICustomizerConfig.description: The settings for 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer.

oreUICustomizerVersion.title: Ore UI Customizer Version
oreUICustomizerVersion.description: The version of 8Crafter's Ore UI Customizer that this config is made for.
oreUICustomizerVersion.$comment: The default value of this should be the latest version of the Ore UI Customizer. The examples of this should include every version of the Ore UI Customizer since v1.0.0.

name.title: Name
name.description: The display name of the config.

id.title: ID
id.description:
The id of the config, used to identify the config when applying the configs, also used to identify the config in error messages, this should be unique.
This is required if the config is from the marketplace.
Must consist only of alphanumeric characters, underscores, hyphens, and periods.

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description:
The UUID of the config, used to uniquely identify the config.
This is required if the config is from the marketplace, or if you wish to have a plugin or theme require the config as a dependency.
If it is not specified a new UUID will be generated upon import.
Must be a valid UUID v4.
uuid.$comment: Do not put an example for this as it may encourage some users to use it, which will result in multiple configs having the same UUID.

description.title: Description
description.description: An optional description of the config.

version.title: Version
version.description:
The version of the config.
This is required if the config is from the marketplace.
This must be a valid semver string, without the leading `v`.

pack_icon_data_uri.title: Pack Icon Data URI
pack_icon_data_uri.description:
The data URI of the icon for the config.
If not specified the default icon will be used.
The MIME type must match `image/*`.

dependencies.title: Dependencies
dependencies.description:
The dependencies of the config.
These dependencies can be other themes, plugins, or configs.

oneOf.title: External Dependency
oneOf.description: A theme, plugin, or config dependency.

uuid.title: UUID
uuid.description:
The UUID of the theme, plugin, or config dependency.
Must be a valid UUID v4.
May also be the UUID of a built-in theme, plugin, or config to force the user to have it enabled to use the config.

version.title: Version
version.description:
The version of the theme, plugin, or config dependency.
Must be a valid semver string, without the leading `v`.
If no version is specified, the latest available version will match, or whatever version is currently active.
NOTE: This field is ignored when the dependency is a built-in theme, plugin, or config.

url.title: URL
url.description: The URL of the website for the config, or just the config creator's website.

marketplaceDetails.title: Marketplace Details
marketplaceDetails.description:
The details of the config in the marketplace.
This is only used if the config is from the marketplace.
This should not be included when uploading the config to the marketplace, as the server will handle adding this information.
This is mutually exclusive with checkForUpdatesDetails.

marketplaceId.title: Marketplace ID
marketplaceId.description:
The ID of the config in the marketplace.
Should be in the format `${configPublisher}.${id}`.

not.$comment: Disallow using the example as the actual value in the config.

originalDownloadURL.title: Original Download URL
originalDownloadURL.description: The original download URL of the config in the marketplace.

not.$comment: Disallow using the example as the actual value in the config.

marketplaceURL.title: Marketplace URL
marketplaceURL.description: The URL of the config in the marketplace.

not.$comment: Disallow using the example as the actual value in the config.

checkForUpdatesDetails.title: Check for Updates Details
checkForUpdatesDetails.description:
The details of the config to check for updates.
This is only used if the config is not from the marketplace.
This allows non-marketplace configs to be checked for updates.
This is mutually exclusive with marketplaceDetails.

versionInfoURL.title: Version Info URL
versionInfoURL.description:
The URL to the JSON object containing the newest version of the config.
The response from this URL should match the https://www.8crafter.com/schemas/ouic/config/checkForUpdatesDetailsVersionInfoResponse.schema.json schema.
When fetching the URL, the response should have an MIME type of `application/json` or `text/json`.
